papers.title: Comparative efficacy and safety of second- and later-line BRAF-targeted regimens in BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer: A systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.authors: Arsalan M, Sawaira F, Hassan I, Hassan T, Khan M, Yasir M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: BRAF V600E mutations occur in approximately 8 to 12% of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) cases and define an aggressive phenotype with poor prognosis. While the BEACON CRC trial established encorafenib-based combinations as effective second-line options, direct head-to-head comparisons among available BRAF-targeted regimens are lacking. This network meta-analysis (NMA) compared the relative efficacy and safety of second- and later-line BRAF-targeted regimens in BRAF V600E-mutant mCRC.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from inception through January 2026. Eligible studies enrolled adult patients with BRAF V600E-mutant mCRC receiving second- or later-line BRAF-targeted therapy and reported time-to-event survival outcomes. A frequentist NMA was conducted under a random-effects model using the netmeta package in R. Hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled for progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Where HRs were unavailable, individual patient data were reconstructed from Kaplan-Meier curves using the Guyot method. Treatment ranking used P-scores, with irinotecan plus cetuximab as the reference comparator.
RESULTS: Four trials enrolling 922 patients across 9 treatment arms were included. All 4 experimental regimens demonstrated significant PFS benefit over irinotecan plus cetuximab. Encorafenib plus cetuximab plus alpelisib ranked highest for PFS (HR 0.33, 95% CI 0.15-0.71; P-score 0.789), followed by encorafenib plus binimetinib plus cetuximab (EBC; HR 0.38, 95% CI 0.29-0.49), encorafenib plus cetuximab (EC; HR 0.40, 95% CI 0.31-0.50), and vemurafenib plus irinotecan plus cetuximab (HR 0.50, 95% CI 0.32-0.77). For OS, only EBC (HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.39-0.69) and EC (HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.46-0.76) achieved statistically significant benefits. No significant difference was detected between EBC and EC on either endpoint. No between-study heterogeneity was detected (I2 = 0%). In the exploratory safety network, encorafenib plus cetuximab was the only encorafenib-based regimen associated with significantly fewer grade ≥ 3 adverse events than irinotecan plus cetuximab (odds ratio 0.67, 95% CI 0.47-0.96).
CONCLUSION: These findings position encorafenib-based therapy, and encorafenib plus cetuximab in particular, as the reference standard for previously treated BRAF V600E-mutant mCRC, while underscoring that the incremental value of more intensive regimens must be weighed against tolerability and confirmed in adequately powered trials.

papers.title_zh: BRAF V600E突變轉移性大腸直腸癌第二線及後線BRAF標靶療法的療效與安全性比較：系統性回顧與網絡統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：BRAF V600E突變約發生於8%至12%的轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）病例，代表一種侵襲性強且預後不良的表型。雖然BEACON CRC試驗已確立以encorafenib為基礎的合併療法是有效的第二線選項，但現有BRAF標靶療法之間仍缺乏直接的頭對頭比較。本網絡統合分析（NMA）比較BRAF V600E突變mCRC第二線及後線BRAF標靶療法的相對療效與安全性。
方法：檢索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL及ClinicalTrials.gov，範圍涵蓋各資料庫建置起至2026年1月。符合資格的研究須納入接受第二線或後線BRAF標靶治療的成年BRAF V600E突變mCRC病人，並報告事件發生時間型存活結果。使用R軟體的netmeta套件，以隨機效應模型進行頻率學派NMA。針對無惡化存活期（PFS）及整體存活期（OS），合併風險比（HR）及其95%信賴區間（CI）。若無法取得HR，則使用Guyot方法，從Kaplan–Meier曲線重建個別病人資料。以P-score進行治療排名，並以irinotecan加cetuximab作為參考比較療法。
結果：共納入4項試驗，涵蓋9個治療組、922名病人。相較於irinotecan加cetuximab，全部4種試驗療法皆呈現統計上顯著的PFS效益。Encorafenib加cetuximab加alpelisib的PFS排名最高（HR 0.33，95% CI 0.15–0.71；P-score 0.789），其次為encorafenib加binimetinib加cetuximab（EBC；HR 0.38，95% CI 0.29–0.49）、encorafenib加cetuximab（EC；HR 0.40，95% CI 0.31–0.50），以及vemurafenib加irinotecan加cetuximab（HR 0.50，95% CI 0.32–0.77）。在OS方面，僅EBC（HR 0.52，95% CI 0.39–0.69）及EC（HR 0.59，95% CI 0.46–0.76）達到統計上顯著的效益。EBC與EC在上述兩個終點皆未偵測到顯著差異。未偵測到研究間異質性（I²＝0%）。在探索性安全性網絡分析中，encorafenib加cetuximab是唯一相較於irinotecan加cetuximab，與顯著較少第3級以上不良事件相關的encorafenib基礎療法（勝算比0.67，95% CI 0.47–0.96）。
結論：這些結果支持將encorafenib基礎療法，尤其是encorafenib加cetuximab，定位為曾接受治療之BRAF V600E突變mCRC的參考標準療法；同時強調，更高強度療法的額外價值必須與耐受性權衡，並由具足夠統計檢定力的試驗確認。
papers.score_reason: 整合4項試驗、922人，提供BRAF V600E突變mCRC後線選藥的實用資訊，值得參與多專科決策者閱讀。惟療法間比較仰賴網絡推論，摘要不足以確認可遞移性與偏誤風險，尚不足以依排名升級療法。

papers.title: MAP of molecular analyses in real-worlD oncology centers - MAPpaMoNDO: a study of the translational research Young GOIM group
papers.authors: Papaccio F, Lombardi P, Giannone G, Carlino F, Petrillo A, Falcone R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Despite the growing number of potential predictive biomarkers, molecular testing in daily oncology practice remains fragmented.
METHODS: The GOIM Young Translational Group conducted a survey to map the molecular testing prescription habits of oncologists across diverse Italian institutions. The survey evaluated general practices and specific tumor types-including gastrointestinal, lung, breast, genitourinary, gynecological, melanoma, and cancer of unknown primary (CUP)-exploring variations in testing frequency, technology, timing, and sample types between academic and non-academic institutions. We also evaluated logistical differences between center types and specific topics of interest, such as Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) implementation, re-biopsy of new lesions, liquid biopsy timing/access and BRCA testing.
RESULTS: Sixty-three responses were collected from 46 institutions, spanning diverse geographical regions and institution types. Molecular analyses are performed entirely in-house in only 40% of cases overall. A marked institutional gap emerged: 60% of academic centers perform all testing internally, compared to just 20% of non-academic centers. Academic centers also demonstrated higher participation in external quality control programs (70% vs. 50%) and more frequently served as regional hubs (60%). Furthermore, a pronounced difference was observed in hereditary cancer testing: in-house germline BRCA1/2 testing for breast cancer is available in 81% of academic institutions compared to only 13% of non-academic centers. Access to liquid biopsy varied across tumor types and center settings. In colorectal cancer, 35.7% of all institutions reported a lack of access, with non-academic centers experiencing a higher rate of non-accessibility (47.8% vs. 21.0% academic), highlighting structural disparities across practice settings.
CONCLUSIONS: This survey provides an overview of current molecular testing practices for solid tumors among a cohort of selected Italian oncology institutions, revealing stark disparities between academic and non-academic centers. While patient-level clinical endpoints, turnaround times, and costs were not directly measured, addressing these institutional variations and supporting patient access to precision oncology will benefit from coordinated nationwide policy harmonization, structural investments in non-academic laboratory infrastructure, and the formalization of managed hub-and-spoke networks.
papers.title_zh: 真實世界腫瘤醫療中心的分子分析版圖——MAPpaMoNDO：GOIM 青年轉譯研究小組的研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：儘管潛在預測性生物標記的數量持續增加，日常腫瘤臨床實務中的分子檢測仍然零散。
方法：GOIM 青年轉譯研究小組進行了一項問卷調查，以描繪義大利各類機構腫瘤科醫師開立分子檢測的習慣。調查評估一般實務及特定腫瘤類型，包括胃腸道、肺、乳房、泌尿生殖系統、婦科腫瘤、黑色素瘤與原發部位不明癌（CUP），探討學術與非學術機構在檢測頻率、技術、時機及檢體類型上的差異。我們也評估不同類型中心之間的作業安排差異，以及特定關注議題，例如次世代定序（NGS）的導入、新病灶的再次切片、液態切片的時機與可近性，以及 BRCA 檢測。
結果：共收集來自46家機構的63份回覆，涵蓋不同地理區域與機構類型。整體而言，僅40%的情況下，分子分析完全於院內進行。機構間出現明顯差距：60%的學術中心在院內完成所有檢測，非學術中心則僅20%。學術中心參與外部品質管制計畫的比例也較高（70% vs. 50%），且較常擔任區域樞紐（60%）。此外，遺傳性癌症檢測亦存在顯著差異：81%的學術機構可於院內提供乳癌的生殖系 BRCA1/2 檢測，非學術中心則僅13%。液態切片的可近性因腫瘤類型與中心類別而異。在大腸直腸癌方面，所有機構中有35.7%回報無法取得液態切片，非學術中心無法取得的比例高於學術中心（47.8% vs. 21.0%），凸顯不同執業場域之間的結構性差距。
結論：本問卷調查概述了一群經選取的義大利腫瘤醫療機構目前對實體腫瘤進行分子檢測的實務，揭示學術與非學術中心之間的明顯差距。雖然本研究未直接測量病人層級的臨床終點、檢測周轉時間與成本，但協調一致的全國政策、對非學術機構實驗室基礎設施的結構性投資，以及將具管理機制的樞紐—衛星網絡正式制度化，將有助於處理這些機構差異，並支持病人取得精準腫瘤醫療。

papers.title: Metabolic reprogramming of myeloid‑derived suppressor cells in colorectal cancer: Mechanistic insights and immunometabolic targeted rehabilitation (Review)
papers.authors: Zhu L, Jiang G, Gao F, Du Y
papers.abstract: Metabolic reprogramming of myeloid‑derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) plays a role in immunotherapy resistance in colorectal cancer (CRC). This metabolic reprogramming appears to be coordinated by oncogenic mutations (such as adenomatous polyposis coli, KRAS and TP53) through a proposed self‑reinforcing 'mutation‑metabolism‑suppression' axis. In the present review, four core metabolic pillars sustaining MDSC pathogenicity and the epimetabolic regulation that durably locks them into a suppressive state were examined. Furthermore, two emerging dimensions were highlighted: The spatial metabolic antagonism through which MDSCs may construct a metabolically hostile zone to limit the functional activity of tertiary lymphoid structures, and the remote manipulation of MDSC function by gut and intratumoral microbiota‑derived metabolites. To transcend the limitations of non‑specific myeloid depletion, immunometabolic rehabilitation is proposed as a potentially transformative framework targeting intrinsic metabolic vulnerabilities to functionally reprogram MDSCs from an immunosuppressive to a homeostatic or immunostimulatory phenotype. By integrating emerging spatial omics for precise target validation, artificial intelligence‑guided rational drug design and microbiome modulation, this paradigm provides a strategic roadmap for next‑generation precision immunotherapy, aiming to achieve durable responses across both microsatellite stable and microsatellite instability‑high CRC.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中髓源抑制細胞的代謝重編程：機轉解析與免疫代謝標靶功能重建（綜述）
papers.abstract_zh: 髓源抑制細胞（MDSCs）的代謝重編程在大腸直腸癌（CRC）的免疫治療抗藥性中扮演一定角色。這種代謝重編程似乎由致癌突變（例如腺瘤性大腸息肉症基因、KRAS 與 TP53 的突變），透過一條假設性的、自我強化的「突變－代謝－抑制」軸加以協調。本綜述檢視了維持 MDSCs 致病作用的四大核心代謝支柱，以及使其長期固定於抑制狀態的表觀代謝調控。此外，本文強調兩個新興面向：其一為空間性代謝拮抗，MDSCs 可能藉此建立代謝上不利的區域，限制三級淋巴結構的功能活性；其二為腸道與腫瘤內微生物群所衍生的代謝物，對 MDSCs 功能進行遠端操控。為突破非專一性髓系細胞清除策略的限制，本文提出「免疫代謝功能重建」，作為一個可能帶來重大轉變的框架，藉由鎖定內在代謝弱點，在功能上將 MDSCs 從免疫抑制表型重編程為維持恆定或促進免疫的表型。透過整合新興空間體學以精準驗證標靶、人工智慧引導的合理藥物設計，以及微生物群調節，此模式為下一代精準免疫治療提供策略路線圖，目標是在微衛星穩定型與高度微衛星不穩定型 CRC 中皆達成持久療效。
papers.score_reason: 摘要提出具生物學合理性的機轉框架，但未提供臨床比較、效應量或系統性證據評讀方法，無法判定治療效益。對台灣大腸直腸外科日常決策的直接實用性低，較適合有免疫代謝轉譯研究需求者閱讀全文。
papers.relevance_why: 主題雖為 CRC，但聚焦 MDSCs 代謝機轉與未來藥物開發，未提供可直接指導手術或圍手術期照護的證據。
papers.one_liner: 本篇綜述CRC中MDSCs代謝重編程的4大支柱，未提供病人數、治療比較或臨床效應量。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；對MSS或MSI-H大腸直腸癌病人，勿據此新增代謝標靶或菌相介入。

pico.P: CRC 中的 MDSCs 與腫瘤免疫微環境；非單一病人世代，摘要未提供病人數。
pico.I: 概念性提出以內在代謝弱點為標靶，重建 MDSCs 功能，並整合空間體學、人工智慧藥物設計及微生物群調節。

papers.title: Ghost (virtual) ileostomy compared with protective ileostomy after low anterior resection for rectal cancer: A GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Mirza W, Anwar S, Hassnain M, Subhani M, Nawaz Z, Khan H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Protective ileostomy is commonly performed after low anterior resection for rectal cancer to mitigate the clinical consequences of anastomotic leakage; however, it is associated with stoma-related and reversal-related morbidity. Ghost ileostomy has emerged as a selective alternative to avoid unnecessary stoma maturation.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis of comparative studies was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to March 31, 2026. Six comparative studies involving 395 patients were included. The primary outcome was anastomotic leakage. Secondary outcomes were length of hospital stay, readmission/rehospitalization, and postoperative ileus. Random-effects models were used. The risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and ROBINS-I, and the certainty of evidence was evaluated using GRADE.
RESULTS: The available evidence did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in anastomotic leakage between ghost and protective ileostomy (RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.64-2.49; I² = 0%). Length of hospital stay was also not significantly different (MD 0.55 days, 95% CI -1.35 to 2.45; I² = 92%). Ghost ileostomy was associated with lower readmission/rehospitalization (RR 0.24, 95% CI 0.06-0.89; I² = 0%) and postoperative ileus (RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.13-0.82; I² = 0%). Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis did not materially alter the interpretation of the heterogeneous hospital-stay outcome. The certainty of evidence was low for anastomotic leakage, readmission, and postoperative ileus and very low for hospital stay.
CONCLUSIONS: The available evidence did not identify a statistically significant difference in anastomotic leakage between ghost and protective ileostomy, although imprecision and limited sample size preclude a definitive conclusion of equivalence. Ghost ileostomy may reduce postoperative ileus and readmission in carefully selected patients; however, larger, adequately powered randomized trials are required before routine adoption.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：直腸癌低位前切除術後常施作保護性迴腸造口，以減輕吻合口洩漏的臨床後果；然而，此作法伴隨造口相關及造口關閉相關併發症。幽靈式迴腸造口已成為一種選擇性替代方案，以避免不必要的正式造口成形。
方法：本比較性研究的系統性回顧與統合分析依循 PRISMA 2020 聲明進行。搜尋 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science 及 Cochrane 對照試驗中央登錄資料庫，搜尋期間自各資料庫建置起至2026年3月31日。共納入6項比較性研究，涉及395名病人。主要結果為吻合口洩漏。次要結果為住院天數、再入院／再次住院，以及術後腸麻痺。採用隨機效應模型。使用 RoB 2 與 ROBINS-I 評估偏誤風險，並使用 GRADE 評估證據確定性。
結果：現有證據未顯示幽靈式與保護性迴腸造口之間的吻合口洩漏具有統計顯著差異（RR 1.27，95% CI 0.64–2.49；I²＝0%）。住院天數亦無統計顯著差異（平均差 MD 0.55天，95% CI −1.35至2.45；I²＝92%）。幽靈式迴腸造口與較低的再入院／再次住院風險（RR 0.24，95% CI 0.06–0.89；I²＝0%）及術後腸麻痺風險（RR 0.33，95% CI 0.13–0.82；I²＝0%）相關。逐一排除研究的敏感度分析，未實質改變對具有異質性的住院天數結果之解讀。吻合口洩漏、再入院及術後腸麻痺的證據確定性為低，住院天數則為極低。
結論：現有證據未發現幽靈式與保護性迴腸造口之間的吻合口洩漏具有統計顯著差異，但估計不精確與樣本數有限，使研究無法對兩者等效作出確定結論。幽靈式迴腸造口可能減少經審慎篩選病人的術後腸麻痺與再入院；然而，在常規採用之前，仍需更大型且統計檢定力充足的隨機試驗。

papers.title: Risk factors for keratoconus: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Chen R, Ou X, Zeng Q
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Keratoconus (KC) is a sight-threatening disease with unclear etiology. Understanding its risk factors is essential for prevention and mechanistic insight. This study presents a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the factors associated with keratoconus, synthesizing the available evidence.
METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was performed in PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Embase, and Web of Science for studies reporting factors associated with keratoconus, with no restrictions on publication date or language, from inception to September 2025. Pooled odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated. At least two authors used the assessment tools of the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) to evaluate the quality of the methodology of the final included studies. Subgroup analysis by region and age was conducted to reduce the heterogeneity among studies. Both quantitative statistical tests (Egger's and Begg's tests) and qualitative funnel plots were employed to comprehensively evaluate the existence of publication bias.
RESULTS: We identified 33 studies involving 1,537,739 individuals: 21 were case-control studies, 4 were cohort studies, and 8 were cross-sectional. 14 factors included in this analysis and their OR (95% CI) are as follows: family history 8.95(5.24, 15.28), eye rubbing 6.20(4.32, 8.91), allergy 1.68(1.25, 2.26), atopy 1.39(0.90, 2.15), eye allergy 6.40(2.44, 16.73), allergic dermatitis/eczema 1.99(1.34, 2.96), asthma 1.63(1.38, 1.93), allergic rhinitis 1.37(1.12, 1.67), inappropriate sleeping position 5.55(1.35, 22.76), dry eye disease 2.55(1.05, 6.18), obesity 1.40(1.03, 1.88), smoking 0.80(0.65, 0.99), inflammatory bowel disease 1.24(0.95, 1.63), diabetes 0.87(0.69, 1.10).
CONCLUSION: Positive family history, eye rubbing, allergy, allergic dermatitis/eczema, asthma, allergic rhinitis, inappropriate sleeping positions, dry eye disease, and obesity are significantly associated with an increased likelihood of keratoconus, whereas smoking exhibited a protective effect. No significant associations were found between KC and atopy, inflammatory bowel disease, or diabetes. Standardized definitions and severity gradings of these factors are needed to clarify causal mechanisms and inform evidence-based preventive strategies.
papers.title_zh: 圓錐角膜的危險因子：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：圓錐角膜（KC）是一種威脅視力、病因尚不明確的疾病。了解其危險因子，對於預防及深入理解致病機轉至關重要。本研究透過全面性的系統性回顧與統合分析，整合現有證據，評估與圓錐角膜相關的因素。
方法：全面搜尋 PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase 與 Web of Science，納入各資料庫建置起至 2025 年 9 月報告圓錐角膜相關因素的研究，不限制發表日期或語言。計算合併勝算比（OR）及其 95% 信賴區間（CI）。至少兩位作者使用 Joanna Briggs Institute（JBI）評讀工具，評估最終納入研究的方法學品質。依地區及年齡進行次群組分析，以降低研究間的異質性。同時採用定量統計檢定（Egger 與 Begg 檢定）及定性漏斗圖，全面評估是否存在發表偏誤。
結果：共納入 33 項研究，涵蓋 1,537,739 人：其中 21 項為病例對照研究、4 項為世代研究、8 項為橫斷面研究。本分析納入的 14 項因素及其 OR（95% CI）如下：家族史 8.95（5.24–15.28）、揉眼 6.20（4.32–8.91）、過敏 1.68（1.25–2.26）、異位性體質 1.39（0.90–2.15）、眼部過敏 6.40（2.44–16.73）、過敏性皮膚炎／濕疹 1.99（1.34–2.96）、氣喘 1.63（1.38–1.93）、過敏性鼻炎 1.37（1.12–1.67）、不當睡姿 5.55（1.35–22.76）、乾眼症 2.55（1.05–6.18）、肥胖 1.40（1.03–1.88）、吸菸 0.80（0.65–0.99）、發炎性腸道疾病 1.24（0.95–1.63）、糖尿病 0.87（0.69–1.10）。
結論：陽性家族史、揉眼、過敏、過敏性皮膚炎／濕疹、氣喘、過敏性鼻炎、不當睡姿、乾眼症與肥胖，皆與圓錐角膜發生可能性增加具有顯著關聯，而吸菸呈現保護效果。KC 與異位性體質、發炎性腸道疾病或糖尿病之間，未發現顯著關聯。這些因素需要標準化定義與嚴重度分級，以釐清因果機轉，並為實證預防策略提供依據。

papers.title: Compositional, Spatial and Functional Changes Occur Within Bacteria Associated With Precancerous Colonic Lesions: A Systematic Review
papers.journal_full: APMIS : acta pathologica, microbiologica, et immunologica Scandinavica
papers.authors: Chieng M, Gögenur M, Hauge M, Bjarnsholt T, Gögenur I
papers.abstract: Most colorectal cancers (CRCs) arise from polyps that develop malignant traits over time. As the majority of these are sporadic, environmental determinants including the gut microbiota are increasingly implicated. Dysbiosis is consistently observed in CRC; however, its association with precancerous polyps is less defined. A systematic review of PubMed, Embase and Web of Science from January 2015 to June 2025 was therefore performed, using the following strings: ('colon' OR 'colorectal') AND ('adenoma' OR 'polyp' OR 'neoplasia') AND ('microbiota' OR 'bacteria') AND ('mucosa' OR 'tissue'). Human studies comparing microbiota of polyp patients with healthy controls were included. Controls were defined a priori as subjects with a normal colonoscopy. Laboratory methods were extracted and study heterogeneity was addressed through narrative synthesis. The search yielded 722 articles, with 27 studies included, involving 4510 participants. Alpha diversity was unchanged in most studies (n = 11/14), whereas beta diversity was altered in the majority (n = 7/13). Escherichia coli, Bacteroides fragilis and Fusobacterium nucleatum were consistently enriched taxa in polyp cohorts (n = 11/27 studies). Bacterial traits associated with adhesion, invasion, and genotoxicity were enriched in polyp subjects alongside metabolic adaptations for stress. However, overt tissue-invasive behaviour was not observed. A decrease in the Firmicutes:Bacteroidetes (F:B) ratio is proposed as a potentially relevant biomarker but requires validation. Future translation of this data into clinical settings requires integration of histopathologic and longitudinal analyses.

papers.abstract_zh: 多數大腸直腸癌（CRC）源自隨時間逐漸產生惡性特徵的息肉。由於其中大多數屬於散發性，包含腸道微生物叢在內的環境決定因子，日益被認為與其發生有關。CRC 中可持續觀察到菌相失衡；然而，菌相失衡與癌前息肉的關聯仍較不明確。因此，本研究對 PubMed、Embase 與 Web of Science 進行系統性回顧，檢索期間為 2015 年 1 月至 2025 年 6 月，使用以下檢索式：('colon' OR 'colorectal') AND ('adenoma' OR 'polyp' OR 'neoplasia') AND ('microbiota' OR 'bacteria') AND ('mucosa' OR 'tissue')。納入比較息肉患者與健康對照者微生物叢的人體研究。對照者事先定義為大腸鏡檢查正常的受試者。研究擷取實驗室方法，並透過敘述性綜合處理研究異質性。檢索共取得 722 篇文章，其中納入 27 項研究，涉及 4510 名參與者。多數研究的 α 多樣性未改變（n＝11/14），而多數研究的 β 多樣性出現改變（n＝7/13）。大腸桿菌（Escherichia coli）、脆弱擬桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）及具核梭桿菌（Fusobacterium nucleatum）是在息肉族群中持續觀察到富集的菌群（n＝11/27 項研究）。息肉受試者中，與黏附、侵入及基因毒性相關的細菌特徵較為富集，並伴隨因應壓力的代謝適應。然而，未觀察到明顯的組織侵入行為。研究提出，厚壁菌門與擬桿菌門的比值（F:B 比值）下降可能是具有相關性的生物標記，但仍需驗證。未來若要將這些資料轉譯至臨床，需整合組織病理學及縱向分析。

papers.title: LEgal Guidance for Cancer Patients and CAREgivers (LEGACY CARE): A Pilot Clinical Trial
papers.authors: Lin K, Kourelis R, Khealani M, Jansen R, Breininger A, Yokanovich L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Medical-legal partnerships can address health-harming legal needs (HHLNs) but caregiver-inclusive models are understudied.
AIMS: To evaluate the feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary efficacy in addressing HHLNs of proactive legal care for patient-caregiver dyads.
METHODS: This single-arm pilot trial (NCT07153016) enrolled patients with advanced-stage colorectal cancer and their self-nominated caregiver. Cancer Legal Care (CLC) provided personalized legal checkups and 3-month follow-up at no cost. Feasibility was assessed by rates of initial checkup, 3-month engagement, and receipt of legal service. Acceptability was assessed by likelihood of recommending the intervention to others. Participant-reported outcomes, implementation measures, and interviews were summarized.
RESULTS: We enrolled 9 of 10 planned dyads. Among the 9 enrolled, 8 completed baseline surveys, 7 completed initial legal checkups, and 7 completed 3-month assessments. Initial legal checkups lasted a median of 45 minutes, and CLC provided median 4 hours of legal service per dyad. At baseline, 7 of 16 participants self-identified HHLNs, while CLC identified 1.7 additional HHLNs per dyad. The study met predefined feasibility benchmarks [initial engagement (16/18, 89%), 3-month questionnaire completion (14/18, 78%), and receipt of ≥ 1 legal service (14/18, 78%)] and acceptability (12/14, 86% recommended the intervention) benchmarks. Dyads noted improvements in financial control, support-seeking, and maintaining daily activities; however, caregiver-specific needs were not consistently identified or prioritized.
CONCLUSIONS: Proactive legal care for recently diagnosed patient-caregiver dyads was feasible and acceptable, and identified and addressed HHLNs. However, caregiver-inclusive medical-legal partnership models may require caregiver-specific intake, longitudinal follow-up, and clearer distinction between patient, caregiver, and shared needs.
papers.title_zh: 癌症病人與照顧者的法律指引（LEGACY CARE）：先導性臨床試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：醫療與法律合作模式可處理損害健康的法律需求（HHLNs），但納入照顧者的模式仍缺乏研究。目的：評估針對病人—照顧者配對提供主動法律照護，在處理HHLNs方面的可行性、可接受性及初步成效。方法：這項單臂先導試驗（NCT07153016）納入晚期大腸直腸癌病人及其自行指定的照顧者。Cancer Legal Care（CLC）免費提供個人化法律需求健檢及3個月追蹤。可行性以完成初次健檢、持續參與至3個月及接受法律服務的比率評估。可接受性則以向他人推薦此介入的可能性評估。研究彙整了參與者自陳結果、執行指標及訪談內容。結果：原訂納入10組配對，實際納入9組。在納入的9組中，8組完成基線問卷，7組完成初次法律需求健檢，7組完成3個月評估。初次法律需求健檢的時間中位數為45分鐘，CLC為每組配對提供法律服務的時間中位數為4小時。基線時，16名參與者中有7名自行辨識出HHLNs，而CLC每組配對額外辨識出1.7項HHLNs。研究達到預先設定的可行性門檻，包括初始參與（16/18，89%）、3個月問卷完成（14/18，78%），以及接受至少1項法律服務（14/18，78%）；也達到可接受性門檻（12/14，86%推薦此介入）。病人—照顧者配對表示，財務掌控、尋求支持及維持日常活動有所改善；然而，照顧者特有的需求並未被一致地辨識或優先處理。結論：對近期確診的病人—照顧者配對提供主動法律照護具有可行性及可接受性，並能辨識及處理HHLNs。然而，納入照顧者的醫療與法律合作模式，可能需要照顧者專屬的初次需求評估、縱向追蹤，以及更清楚區分病人、照顧者及雙方共同的需求。

papers.title: Conformal sphincter preservation operation versus modified Bacon operation for ultralow rectal cancer: a multicenter retrospective study using propensity-score matching and inverse probability of treatment weighting
papers.authors: Ding H, Yuan B, Sun G, Yu G, Gong H, Zhu X
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: This study aimed to compare perioperative results, postoperative anal function, quality of life (QoL), and long-term outcomes between conformal sphincter preservation operation (CSPO) and modified Bacon operation for ultralow rectal cancer.
METHODS: Patients with ultralow rectal cancer undergoing CSPO (n = 123) and modified Bacon (n = 109) were included from Changhai and Xiangya Hospital, respectively, between 2011 and 2020. Propensity score matching (PSM) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were used to balanced baseline characteristics. Anal function was evaluated with Wexner scores and low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) score, and visual analog scale (VAS) for satisfaction. QoL was evaluated via EORTC QLQ-C30 and QLQ-CR38 questionnaires.
RESULTS: After exclusions, 122 patients in the CSPO group and 108 in the modified Bacon group were analyzed. Following adjustment via PSM and IPTW, the CSPO group demonstrated a shorter operative time, postoperative hospital stay, flatus and defecation time, postoperative anal function recovery time, and better satisfaction with anal function compared to the modified Bacon group. Multivariable analysis showed that neoadjuvant radiotherapy (β=-1.184, 95% CI -1.95 to 0.42) and postoperative anal function recovery time (β=-0.184, 95% CI -0.25 to -0.12) significantly contributed to lower satisfaction with anal function.
CONCLUSION: This retrospective, observational, multicenter study compared CSPO with the modified Bacon for ultralow rectal cancer. Both approaches demonstrated comparable clinical efficacy, functional outcomes, and QoL. However, CSPO showed potential advantages in perioperative recovery, postoperative anal functional recovery, and patient-reported anal function satisfaction. These findings require confirmation in prospective studies.

papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究旨在比較超低位直腸癌接受適形保肛手術（CSPO）與改良式 Bacon 手術後的圍手術期結果、術後肛門功能、生活品質（QoL）及長期結果。
方法：納入2011至2020年間分別於長海醫院及湘雅醫院接受 CSPO（n＝123）與改良式 Bacon 手術（n＝109）的超低位直腸癌病人。使用傾向分數配對（PSM）及治療逆機率加權（IPTW）平衡基線特徵。肛門功能以 Wexner 評分及低位前位切除症候群（LARS）評分評估，滿意度則以視覺類比量表（VAS）評估。生活品質使用 EORTC QLQ-C30 及 QLQ-CR38 問卷評估。
結果：排除後，分析納入 CSPO 組122人及改良式 Bacon 組108人。經 PSM 與 IPTW 調整後，相較於改良式 Bacon 組，CSPO 組的手術時間、術後住院時間、排氣與排便所需時間及術後肛門功能恢復時間較短，且肛門功能滿意度較佳。多變項分析顯示，術前新輔助放射治療（β＝-1.184，95% CI -1.95至0.42）及術後肛門功能恢復時間（β＝-0.184，95% CI -0.25至-0.12）均顯著促成較低的肛門功能滿意度。
結論：本回溯性、觀察性、多中心研究比較了超低位直腸癌的 CSPO 與改良式 Bacon 手術。兩種術式呈現相近的臨床療效、功能結果及生活品質。然而，CSPO 在圍手術期恢復、術後肛門功能恢復及病人自述肛門功能滿意度方面顯示潛在優勢。這些發現仍需前瞻性研究確認。

papers.title: Robotic transabdominal specimen extraction vs. transanal specimen extraction for sigmoid and upper rectal cancer: a comparative analysis of short-term outcomes
papers.authors: Li T, Luo A, Min F, Yu T, Zou Y, Zuo J
papers.abstract: Robotic surgery has become an established approach for the management of patients with sigmoid colon and upper rectal cancer (SURC). Natural orifice specimen extraction surgery (NOSES), which avoids an additional abdominal wall incision, is a widely used minimally invasive approach in colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. It remains uncertain whether transanal specimen extraction, classified as type IV natural orifice specimen extraction surgery (NOSES-IV), offers advantages over conventional transabdominal specimen extraction (TASE) during robot-assisted surgery for SURC. We retrospectively compared the perioperative outcomes of the two extraction strategies. We retrospectively reviewed 254 patients who underwent robot-assisted surgery for SURC at the First Affiliated Hospital of Jiangxi Medical College, Nanchang University, between January 2019 and January 2026. Ninety-one patients received NOSES-IV, and 163 received TASE. After 1:1 propensity score matching (PSM), 83 patients per group were included, and their short-term perioperative outcomes were compared. After matching, the baseline characteristics did not differ significantly between the two groups. Compared with the TASE group, the NOSES-IV group had a shorter gastrointestinal reconstruction time (P < 0.001) and less intraoperative blood loss (P = 0.022). Patients in the NOSES-IV group also ambulated (P = 0.029), passed flatus (P = 0.018), and resumed semiliquid diet earlier (P = 0.038). On postoperative days 1, 3 and 5, their C-reactive protein levels were lower (P = 0.017). They also had fewer incision-related complications (P = 0.014), a shorter postoperative hospital stay (P = 0.034), and lower visual analogue scale (VAS) pain scores (P = 0.008). In this retrospective, propensity score-matched cohort, compared with TASE, robot-assisted NOSES-IV for SURC was associated with fewer incision-related complications, less postoperative pain, and earlier recovery. The total operative time, lymph node yield, resection margin status, and anorectal function at 3 months did not differ between the groups. These findings suggest that NOSES-IV is a feasible option for appropriately selected patients, but confirmation in larger, multicentre, prospective studies with longer follow-up is needed.

papers.abstract_zh: 機器手臂手術已成為乙狀結腸與上段直腸癌（SURC）病人的確立治療方式。自然孔道取標本手術（NOSES）可避免額外的腹壁切口，是大腸直腸癌（CRC）手術中廣泛使用的微創方式。在SURC機器手臂輔助手術中，歸類為第IV型自然孔道取標本手術（NOSES-IV）的經肛門取標本，是否優於傳統經腹取標本（TASE），仍不確定。我們以回溯方式比較這兩種取標本策略的圍手術期結果。我們回溯檢視2019年1月至2026年1月間，於南昌大學江西醫學院第一附屬醫院接受SURC機器手臂輔助手術的254名病人。其中91名接受NOSES-IV，163名接受TASE。經1：1傾向分數配對（PSM）後，每組納入83名病人，並比較其短期圍手術期結果。配對後，兩組基線特徵無統計顯著差異。與TASE組相比，NOSES-IV組的腸胃道重建時間較短（P < 0.001），術中失血量較少（P = 0.022）。NOSES-IV組病人也較早下床活動（P = 0.029）、排氣（P = 0.018）及恢復半流質飲食（P = 0.038）。在術後第1、3及5天，其C反應蛋白濃度較低（P = 0.017）。他們的切口相關併發症也較少（P = 0.014）、術後住院時間較短（P = 0.034），且視覺類比量表（VAS）疼痛分數較低（P = 0.008）。在這個回溯性、傾向分數配對世代中，相較於TASE，SURC機器手臂輔助NOSES-IV與較少的切口相關併發症、較輕的術後疼痛及較早恢復有關。兩組的總手術時間、淋巴結取得數、切緣狀態及術後3個月肛門直腸功能並無差異。這些發現顯示，NOSES-IV對適當選擇的病人而言是可行選項，但仍須以更大型、多中心、追蹤時間更長的前瞻性研究確認。

papers.title: Targeting the ANKRD54/ELOVL6 axis suppresses malignancy in BRAF mutant colorectal cancer by disrupting fatty acid metabolism and promoting ferroptosis
papers.journal_full: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
papers.authors: Hou Y, Wu D, Wei Y, Yu B, Shao D, Cao D
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: BRAF-mutant (BRAF-MT) colorectal cancer (CRC) represents a clinically aggressive subtype characterized by distinct biological features and significantly worse prognosis compared to BRAF wild-type (BRAF-WT) CRC, with median survival reduced by approximately 40%. The therapeutic resistance of BRAF-MT CRC stems primarily from BRAF-driven dysregulation of tumor cell proliferation. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying the aggressive phenotype and potential therapeutic vulnerabilities remain incompletely understood.
METHODS: Bioinformatic analyses were employed to identify candidate genes. A combination of in vitro (cell proliferation, clonal formation), ex vivo (patient-derived and mouse intestinal organoids), and in vivo (xenograft models) assays were used to assess oncogenic function. Mechanistic investigations included Western blotting, qRT-PCR, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP), and luciferase reporter assays to delineate the regulatory axis. Fatty acid metabolism and ferroptosis were evaluated by a combination of metabolomic, biochemical, and cellular assays.
RESULTS: Bioinformatic screening identified ankyrin repeat domain 54 (ANKRD54) as selectively overexpressed in BRAF-MT CRC and significantly associated with adverse prognosis. Inhibition of ANKRD54 markedly suppressed clonogenic potential, cellular proliferation in vitro, organoid formation in both PDOs and cKI mouse-derived organoids, and tumor growth in vivo. Mechanistically, lysine acetyltransferase 2 A (KAT2A) promoted ANKRD54 transcriptional activation through H3K27 acetylation. ANKRD54 subsequently formed a functional complex with CCAAT/enhancer binding protein beta (CEBPB), cooperatively inducing ELOVL fatty acid elongase 6 (ELOVL6) expression. This KAT2A-mediated ANKRD54/CEBPB/ELOVL6 transcriptional axis reprogrammed fatty acid metabolism, selectively suppressing ferroptosis in BRAF-MT CRC. Pharmacological targeting of either ANKRD54 or ELOVL6 substantially enhanced the therapeutic efficacy of Vemurafenib-based treatment in BRAF-MT CRC models. Clinical data corroborated that elevated ANKRD54 expression promoted malignant progression and predicted poor outcomes through this ELOVL6-dependent metabolic pathway.
CONCLUSIONS: This study elucidates a novel KAT2A-mediated ANKRD54/CEBPB/ELOVL6 axis driving aggressive tumor behavior through regulating fatty acid metabolic and ferroptosis evasion. These findings establish ANKRD54 and ELOVL6 as promising therapeutic targets for combination strategies to overcome therapeutic resistance in BRAF-MT CRC patients.

papers.title_zh: 靶向 ANKRD54/ELOVL6 軸藉由干擾脂肪酸代謝並促進鐵死亡，抑制 BRAF 突變型大腸直腸癌的惡性表現
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：BRAF 突變型（BRAF-MT）大腸直腸癌（CRC）是一種臨床上侵襲性高的亞型，具有獨特的生物學特徵，且相較於 BRAF 野生型（BRAF-WT）CRC，預後顯著較差，中位存活期約縮短 40%。BRAF-MT CRC 的治療抗性主要源自 BRAF 驅動的腫瘤細胞增殖失調。然而，其侵襲性表型背後的分子機制，以及潛在可供治療利用的弱點，仍未完全釐清。
方法：研究以生物資訊分析辨識候選基因，並結合體外試驗（細胞增殖、集落形成）、離體試驗（病人來源及小鼠腸道類器官），以及體內試驗（異種移植模型）評估其致癌功能。機制研究包括西方墨點法、定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（qRT-PCR）、共同免疫沉澱（Co-IP）、染色質免疫沉澱（ChIP）及螢光素酶報導基因試驗，以解析此調控軸。脂肪酸代謝與鐵死亡則透過代謝體學、生化及細胞試驗的組合進行評估。
結果：生物資訊篩選發現，錨蛋白重複序列結構域蛋白 54（ANKRD54）在 BRAF-MT CRC 中選擇性過度表現，且與不良預後顯著相關。抑制 ANKRD54 可明顯降低體外細胞的集落形成能力與增殖、病人來源類器官（PDOs）及 cKI 小鼠來源類器官的形成，以及體內腫瘤生長。在機制上，離胺酸乙醯轉移酶 2A（KAT2A）透過 H3K27 乙醯化促進 ANKRD54 的轉錄活化。ANKRD54 隨後與 CCAAT／增強子結合蛋白 β（CEBPB）形成具功能的複合體，共同誘導 ELOVL 脂肪酸延長酶 6（ELOVL6）的表現。此由 KAT2A 介導的 ANKRD54/CEBPB/ELOVL6 轉錄軸會重新編程脂肪酸代謝，選擇性抑制 BRAF-MT CRC 的鐵死亡。在 BRAF-MT CRC 模型中，以藥物靶向 ANKRD54 或 ELOVL6，均可大幅增強以 Vemurafenib 為基礎之治療的療效。臨床資料亦支持，ANKRD54 表現升高會透過此依賴 ELOVL6 的代謝途徑促進惡性進展，並預測不良預後。
結論：本研究闡明一條新穎、由 KAT2A 介導的 ANKRD54/CEBPB/ELOVL6 軸，透過調控脂肪酸代謝及逃避鐵死亡，驅動腫瘤的侵襲性行為。這些發現確立 ANKRD54 與 ELOVL6 為具潛力的治療標的，可用於旨在克服 BRAF-MT CRC 病人治療抗性的合併治療策略。

papers.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitors combined with VEGF/VEGFR-targeted therapy in microsatellite-stable advanced colorectal cancer: clinical advances and the potential for immune-sensitive tumor conversion
papers.authors: Wang R, Zhou X, Yuan M, Wang Z
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, and mismatch repair-proficient/microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) tumors account for the majority of metastatic CRC cases. In contrast to dMMR/MSI-H CRC, pMMR/MSS tumors are typically characterized by low immunogenicity, limited neoantigen presentation, insufficient effector T-cell infiltration, and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, which collectively restrict the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) monotherapy. Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)/VEGF receptor (VEGFR) signaling contributes not only to abnormal angiogenesis but also to immune suppression by impairing dendritic-cell maturation, reducing immune-cell trafficking, promoting T-cell dysfunction, and facilitating the accumulation of immunosuppressive cell populations. These mechanisms provide a strong rationale for combining VEGF/VEGFR-targeted therapy with ICIs to normalize tumor vasculature and remodel the immune microenvironment. Clinical evidence for this strategy in advanced pMMR/MSS CRC remains heterogeneous. Treatment activity varies across therapeutic settings, antiangiogenic agents, and combination regimens, while many studies are limited by small sample sizes, single-arm designs, and substantial differences in patient characteristics. Emerging data suggest that metastatic pattern, molecular features, baseline immune contexture, and treatment line may influence clinical activity; however, no biomarker has yet been validated for routine patient selection. Multi-agent strategies may provide broader immune modulation but also increase toxicity, treatment complexity, and cost. This review summarizes the biological rationale, clinical efficacy, safety, and potential predictive factors of VEGF/VEGFR-targeted therapy combined with ICIs in advanced pMMR/MSS CRC. Particular emphasis is placed on the heterogeneity of clinical outcomes and on distinguishing mechanistic immune remodeling from the potential enhancement of tumor immune sensitivity. Future studies should prioritize biomarker-guided patient selection, randomized comparative trials, and comprehensive assessment of efficacy, safety, quality of life, and long-term clinical benefit.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球癌症相關罹病與死亡的主要原因之一，而錯配修復功能正常／微衛星穩定型（pMMR/MSS）腫瘤占轉移性CRC病例的大多數。相較於dMMR/MSI-H CRC，pMMR/MSS腫瘤通常具有低免疫原性、新抗原呈現有限、效應T細胞浸潤不足，以及免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境等特徵，這些因素共同限制了免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICI）單藥治療的療效。血管內皮生長因子（VEGF）／VEGF受體（VEGFR）訊息傳遞不僅促進異常血管新生，也會透過妨礙樹突細胞成熟、減少免疫細胞遷移、促進T細胞功能障礙，以及促使免疫抑制性細胞族群累積，造成免疫抑制。這些機轉為VEGF/VEGFR標靶治療合併ICI提供了充分的理論依據，期望藉此使腫瘤血管正常化並重塑免疫微環境。此策略用於晚期pMMR/MSS CRC的臨床證據仍具異質性。治療活性隨治療情境、抗血管新生藥物及合併療法組合而異，而許多研究受到樣本數小、單臂設計及病人特徵差異顯著等限制。新興資料顯示，轉移型態、分子特徵、基線免疫組成與空間分布，以及治療線別可能影響臨床活性；然而，目前尚無經驗證可供常規病人篩選使用的生物標記。多藥策略可能提供更廣泛的免疫調節，但也會增加毒性、治療複雜度及成本。本綜述彙整VEGF/VEGFR標靶治療合併ICI用於晚期pMMR/MSS CRC的生物學理論依據、臨床療效、安全性及潛在預測因子。本文特別著重於臨床結果的異質性，並區分機轉層面的免疫重塑與腫瘤免疫敏感性可能提升這兩個概念。未來研究應優先著重以生物標記引導病人篩選、隨機比較試驗，以及全面評估療效、安全性、生活品質與長期臨床效益。

papers.title: Outcome measurement in perianal Crohn's disease
papers.authors: Joshi S, Hart A, Tozer P
papers.abstract: Perianal Crohn's disease (pCD) is a distinct and debilitating phenotype of Crohn's disease and an independent predictor of long-term adverse outcomes. Traditionally, outcome measurement has focused on fistula healing to assess treatment success; however, as we recognise distinct classes of patients and shift towards shared decision making, healthcare professionals are increasingly acknowledging the importance of assessing more nuanced outcomes such as downstaging, quality of life, sex and intimacy and the impact on family, education or work. Current challenges in outcome measurement include substantial heterogeneity in definitions, measurement tools and time points used. This review will cover the current landscape, reporting on historical measurement instruments, such as the fistula drainage assessment (FDA), perianal disease activity index (PDAI) and the collective move towards patient-centred and patient-developed tools, such as the Crohn's anal fistula quality of life scale (CAF-QoL). It will also assess the value of core outcome measurement sets, which provide a uniform but flexible framework to standardise outcome reporting across studies and support comparison of interventions in clinical practice. Importantly, the incorporation of patient perspectives within their methodology ensures that their recommendations reflect outcomes that truly matter to those with pCD. The contemporary need is for novel clinical and radiological tools to monitor perianal disease activity that are predictive, preventative and provide treatment thresholds, so that patients can live well with their fistulising disease, if it cannot be eradicated. There will no doubt also be a role for digital applications and artificial intelligence in enhancing outcome measurement further for perianal Crohn's disease.

papers.title_zh: 肛門周圍Crohn氏症的結果測量
papers.abstract_zh: 肛門周圍Crohn氏症（pCD）是Crohn氏症中一種獨特且令人衰弱的表現型，也是長期不良結果的獨立預測因子。傳統上，結果測量著重於以瘻管癒合評估治療成功；然而，隨著我們辨識出不同的病人類型，並轉向共享決策，醫療專業人員日益體認到評估更細緻結果的重要性，例如疾病降階、生活品質、性生活與親密關係，以及對家庭、教育或工作的影響。目前結果測量面臨的挑戰，包括所使用的定義、測量工具與評估時間點存在顯著異質性。本綜述將涵蓋目前的發展概況，介紹過往的測量工具，例如瘻管引流評估（FDA）、肛門周圍疾病活動指數（PDAI），以及整體朝向以病人為中心、由病人參與開發之工具的趨勢，例如Crohn氏症肛門瘻管生活品質量表（CAF-QoL）。本文也將評估核心結果測量集的價值；這類測量集提供統一但具彈性的架構，以標準化各研究的結果報告，並支持臨床實務中不同介入措施的比較。重要的是，在其方法學中納入病人觀點，可確保所提出的建議反映對pCD病人真正重要的結果。當前需要的是新型臨床與影像學工具，能監測肛門周圍疾病活動、具備預測與預防功能，並提供治療門檻，使病人在瘻管性疾病無法根除時，仍能與疾病共存並維持良好生活。毫無疑問，數位應用程式與人工智慧也將在進一步改善肛門周圍Crohn氏症的結果測量上扮演角色。

papers.title: Proxy-mediated bias in non-invasive colorectal cancer risk predictors: an evidence appraisal for multiethnic Southeast Asian population
papers.authors: Suhaimei U, Rahman H, Kassim N, Mohammad N, Naing L
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is rising across Southeast Asia (SEA) and leads by incidence in Brunei Darussalam. Machine learning (ML) applications for CRC in ASEAN remain endoscopy-based and diagnostic; no risk-stratification model using routinely collected non-invasive data has been reported. This review asks not which predictors associate with CRC risk, but which can serve as valid, equitable ML inputs in multiethnic SEA populations, where lifestyle variables may encode ethnic or religious identity rather than biological risk (proxy-mediated bias).
METHODS: This narrative review used qualitative synthesis rather than meta-analysis. PubMed, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched to 9 July 2026 (English language). Six predictor categories were appraised for Asian evidence strength, SEA-specific data, and proxy-bias risk: dietary and lifestyle factors, anthropometric measures, faecal immunochemical test (FIT), complete blood count (CBC), medication history, and emerging predictors; 22 studies were prioritised for appraisal.
RESULTS: FIT and BMI (Asian threshold ≥23.0 kg/m2) showed the most consistent Asian evidence; FIT, with age, sex and CBC, carried the lowest proxy-bias risk. CBC-based ML performs well in Western populations (AUC 0.736-0.82) but is unvalidated in any Asian population. The central paradox: the most available predictor has the weakest regional evidence, whilst those with strongest Asian evidence are most entangled with identity. Lifestyle predictors require explicit proxy-bias management; medication-history evidence was inconsistent.
CONCLUSION: A four-criterion framework (effect size, biological plausibility, proxy-bias risk, and routine data availability) and a two-pathway delivery model provide an evidence-grounded basis for equitable, risk-stratified CRC early detection in Brunei and comparable SEA systems.
papers.title_zh: 非侵入性大腸直腸癌風險預測因子的代理變項介導偏誤：針對東南亞多族群人口的證據評析
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：東南亞（SEA）的大腸直腸癌（CRC）發生率持續上升，且在汶萊各類癌症中居首。東協地區的CRC機器學習（ML）應用仍以內視鏡及診斷為主；尚未有使用常規蒐集之非侵入性資料的風險分層模型被報告。本綜述探討的不是哪些預測因子與CRC風險相關，而是哪些因子能在東南亞多族群人口中，作為有效且公平的ML輸入變項；在這些人口中，生活型態變項可能編碼的是族群或宗教身分，而非生物學風險，即代理變項介導偏誤。
方法：本敘述性綜述採用質性綜合，而非統合分析。搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Google Scholar，搜尋截至2026年7月9日，限英文文獻。針對六類預測因子，評估其亞洲證據強度、東南亞特定資料及代理偏誤風險：飲食與生活型態因素、人體測量指標、糞便免疫化學檢查（FIT）、全血球計數（CBC）、用藥史及新興預測因子；優先選取22項研究進行評析。
結果：FIT與BMI（亞洲切點≥23.0 kg/m²）具有最一致的亞洲證據；FIT連同年齡、性別與CBC，具有最低的代理偏誤風險。以CBC為基礎的ML在西方人口表現良好（AUC 0.736–0.82），但尚未在任何亞洲人口中獲得驗證。核心矛盾在於：最容易取得的預測因子，其區域證據最薄弱；而亞洲證據最強的預測因子，卻與身分特徵糾纏最深。生活型態預測因子需要明確的代理偏誤管理；用藥史的證據則不一致。
結論：由四項準則（效應大小、生物學合理性、代理偏誤風險及常規資料可取得性）構成的架構，以及雙路徑服務提供模式，為汶萊及類似東南亞體系推動公平、依風險分層的CRC早期偵測，提供了以證據為基礎的依據。
